name: Institutions — working on alignment
description: 30 organisations working on alignment, AI safety and humane technology: technical research, testing and evaluation, governance and policy, public-interest research and more. Each is described from its own site (checked 2026-09-24) and links out to it. Listing is not endorsement, and nothing is ranked.

items.name: Institutions
items.description: 30 organisations working on alignment, AI safety and humane technology, grouped by the kind of work they do.

sections.What it is: 30 organisations working on alignment, AI safety and humane technology, by quite different routes. Each card describes the organisation from its own site and links out to it.
sections.How to read it: Listing is not endorsement, and nothing here is ranked: the groups follow the kind of work, and many organisations work across several. The list is not complete; an issue or a pull request against research/institutions/institutions.json in the public repo is how to add one or correct one.
